study type: Meta-analysis of cohort studies (prospective and retrospective)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 50,472 women from six studies, with 39,659 having endometriosis and 10,813 without endometriosis.
finding: Women with endometriosis at pregnancy have an increased risk of preterm birth (odds ratio, 1.473; 95% confidence interval, 1.216 to 1.785).
